about.title: About This Site
about.subtitle: Your go-to English resource for travel in China — written and curated by people who actually live here
about.offerSubtitle: Everything you need for a smooth, unforgettable China trip
about.ctaSubtitle: Dive into our curated vlogs, guides and city pages to build an itinerary that fits your style.
about.missionP1: China is enormous. It's also endlessly fascinating — 5,000 years of history, dozens of cuisines, and landscapes that stretch from tropical islands to snow-capped mountains. But for first-time visitors, figuring out how to navigate it all can feel overwhelming.
about.missionP2: That's where we come in. We're a team of travel writers and long-term residents based across China — from Beijing to Chengdu to Xi'an and beyond. Instead of another generic guide, we curate the best of what's out there: vlogs from real travelers, articles that actually work, and local partners we'd recommend to a friend.
about.missionP3: Whether you're here for the Terracotta Warriors, a Sichuan hot pot adventure, or a quiet moment with the pandas, we want to help you plan a trip that's authentic, stress-free, and uniquely yours.
about.f1Desc: Handpicked video stories from Bilibili and YouTube, each with our honest notes.
about.f2Desc: The best articles from bloggers, forums and locals — organized by topic.
about.f3Desc: Attractions, food, itineraries and tips for every major destination.
about.f4Desc: Verified drivers, guides and photographers you can actually book.
about.f5Desc: Visa, transport, payment and app guides to keep your trip running smoothly.
about.f6Desc: Clear, conversational English with the context you need — no insider assumptions.
